 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Each nonzero object is a 3x3 plus sign. Arrange their patches left-to-right
    # in ascending color order.
    colors = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0})
    patches = {}
    for color in colors:
        cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
        patches[color] = [[grid[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] for dc in range(3)] for dr in range(3)]
    return [[patches[color][r][c] for color in colors for c in range(3)] for r in range(3)]
"
